# Adani Ports and Special Economic Zone Limited

<!-- Generated by `make client-docs`. Do not edit inside the markers. -->

Researched 2026-09-29 · status **complete** · Budget reached: one full annual report (609pp) mined for CSR narrative, statutory BRSR CSR/Section-135 disclosures, footprints, partners, programs and metrics across the three target years; a dedicated Rule-8 CSR annexure with prescribed CSR/average net profit was not present in this integrated report and a fresh MCA CSR-2 filing or the FY22/FY23 annual reports were not separately fetched due to budget.

Adani Ports and Special Economic Zone Limited (APSEZ, CIN L63090GJ1998PLC034182) is confirmed as a distinct, Section-135-bound listed company (BRSR FY2023-24: 'Whether CSR is applicable... Yes'), separate from Adani Foundation, which the annual report repeatedly names as its CSR implementing agency ('We undertook a plethora of CSR initiatives in the reporting year through the Adani Foundation'). The FY2023-24 Integrated Annual Report's ESG section gives a 3-year CSR spend chart: FY2021-22 Rs 109.7 crore, FY2022-23 Rs 115.1 crore, FY2023-24 Rs 112.3 crore. BRSR Principle 8 discloses one aspirational-district CSR spend line (Andhra Pradesh/Vishakhapatnam, Rs 6,15,00,000) and beneficiary counts by CSR theme (Community Health 2,85,774; Sustainable Livelihoods 1,38,214; Education 32,946; Community Development 34,288; Climate Action 27,002; Emergency Response 13,400; Community Infra 8,360). Extensive footprint detail was captured across Gujarat (Mundra, Bharuch/Dahej-Netrang, Surat/Hazira-Junagam), Odisha (Dhamra/Bhadrak), Tamil Nadu (Kattupalli), Kerala (Vizhinjam), Andhra Pradesh (Krishnapatnam, Visakhapatnam/Gangavaram) and Maharashtra (Dighi/Raigad), along with programmes run through Adani Foundation (Utthan, Udaan, SuPoshan, Kamdhenu, Vruksh Se Vikas, Aahaar, AEEC) and several government/institutional partners (Zilla Parishad Raigad, Odisha Housing & Urban Development Dept, DAV Managing Committee). No prior catalog record existed for APSEZ, Adani Ports or Adani Foundation, so every finding is a NEW RECORD; nothing conflicts with an existing dossier since none was held. Precise prescribed-CSR (2% obligation), average net profit, unspent/excess amounts, impact-assessment-done flag, and CSR-1 registration numbers were not located within budget and are marked not_found; the FY2022-23 and FY2021-22 totals rely solely on the 3-year chart in the FY2023-24 report rather than each year's own filing.

Website: https://www.adaniports.com

- identity: legal name, funder_type, section_135_bound, website

- footprints: Mundra, Kandla, Kattupalli and other port-region districts paired with correct state
- stated priority geography separate from footprint
- partners (Adani Foundation as implementing agency, plus government/other CSR partners)
- programs/themes run through Adani Foundation
- metrics on CSR outreach and beneficiaries
- contacts and documents
